summary: URLSession-style HTTP(S) with redirects, download and a memory cache exists, and GCD and ProcessInfo have SDK counterparts. Bonjour, XPC, streams/sockets/ports and Process/NSTask have no app-facing API.

features.feature: URL Loading: sessions, requests, data and download tasks
features.note: shared session, data_task, download_task with progress, streaming bytes, redirects up to 5; no upload tasks, background sessions, delegates or configurations
memory cache honouring Cache-Control and ETag; no disk cache or per-request cache policies

features.feature: URL Loading: cookies, credentials, authentication challenges
features.bifrost: springboard/src/deildu/http.rs (cookie jar in the shell transport only)
features.note: cookie jar is internal to the shell HTTP client, not exposed through URLSession

features.feature: URL Loading: WebSocket and streaming tasks
features.note: no WebSocket client in the SDK

features.feature: URL Loading: custom protocols and proxies, URL components
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. transport is swappable internally for tests only
no mDNS/DNS-SD code in springboard or the SDK

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/control.rs (JSON-RPC over owner-only Unix socket); docs/app-isolation.md
features.note: control socket serves RPC to an app with SO_PEERCRED check; no general app-to-service connection API or XPC services

features.feature: Object Runtime: exceptions, invocation, KVO, proxies
features.note: Objective-C runtime concepts; Rust has no counterpart. Observation covered by observable.rs

features.feature: Processes and Threads: queues and concurrency
features.note: GCD-style DispatchQueue, group, work item, QoS and a main queue; no OperationQueue or RunLoop

features.feature: Processes and Threads: process information and activity
features.note: memory, cores, uptime, thermal state, low power mode, beginActivity, sudden termination

features.feature: Processes and Threads: launching child processes
features.note: shell launches sandboxed apps under bubblewrap and cgroups; apps get no Process/Pipe wrapper (Rust std::process is available)

Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. std::net and std::io are usable directly; no stream or port abstractions with run-loop scheduling

gaps: Cookie storage, credentials and auth challenges in URLSession
Upload tasks, background sessions, disk URLCache
